notes.title: 'We have more levels than players': This indie dev's game was a complete flop, but he's powering through with his plan to release 20 seasons of new content anyway
notes.notes:
I was initially attracted to Endlight, a weird indie game about getting hoops, by its intense, almost overwhelming trailer, but what hooked me were the less obvious but very clever bits lying beneath its sensory onslaught: Levels are punctuated by odd, sometimes very funny chunks of text that made me feel as though developer Jim McGinley was watching and talking in the background as I played. I also loved the game's central conceit: Every level can only be completed once. After it's done, it's gone forever...

notes.title: 07 - Fun Update - IGN, IGF, some players!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39050440/60ce7ab654a7c66f293fc62613136d72a4f6c814.gif

We're hard at work completing Endlight for November 2021. We had hoped to release in September, BUT few know Endlight exists. Rather than release to oblivion, we moved dates (apologies, especially to Miyazo). We've doubled down on marketing, and hopefully you'll get sick of hearing about Endlight. Ongoing detailed development updates can be found here:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1299860/discussions/0/2953788788209557410/


IGN covered Endlight for Gamescom 2021!
Checkout the 2 minute custom trailer we created!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gSLCM16Ol2g
The visuals are great, but that voiceover - TERRIBLE! I thought it was passable, but hearing it now I cringe. The voiceover was a rush job for reasons that will only bore you. I focused so much on the words explaining Endlight, I overlooked the presentation of said words. This will haunt me for the REST OF MY DAYS. That being said, I do like how the video ends :)

Today that video has 349 likes and 309 dislikes. Based on the comments (always read the comments, they're fantastic!) it appears viewers either love or hate Endlight's insanity - there is no in-between. We've potentially (and unintentionally) created the most polarizing game of 2021. I mean, we just wanted to maximize your GPU - is that so wrong?!

...
Watch Cyber_Akuma BEAT the Demo
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Mq1Y7T6sMH8
It takes him 22 minutes to reach the final level, then another 15 trying to beat it ... BUT BEAT IT HE DID! Proof that Endlight, despite the dizzying insanity, is the easiest game ever made.

...
We will be submitting Endlight to GDC IGF 2022
This is our NINTH attempt. Multiple failed attempts have produced this amazing twitter rabbit hole:
https://twitter.com/misterbigpants/status/1434246992084021249
Will this thread celebrate a 10th anniversary? Hopefully NOT!

....
Oomfielord tweets:
https://twitter.com/Oomfielord/status/1431374938888450048
"Yeah man great demo but im never playing this again for the sake of my eyesight and my brain. Who tf thought this game was a good idea bruh". The entire thread is amazing. However, Oomfielord finished the demo! Despite what's written I'm pretty confident we've found OUR BIGGEST FAN!

....
Endlight - First Impressions by Indiecator
https://indiecator.home.blog/2021/09/23/endlight-first-impressions/
Short story: Does NOT recommend!
Long story: We'll change their mind!
Indiecator's concerns are valid, BUT we can address them all and WE SHALL! Don't worry Indiecator, we'll make you PROUD YET!!! Worth noting that this is not the first time eyeball exhaustion has been mentioned, and we'll be providing configuration options to address that.

....
Miyazo tweets:
https://twitter.com/Miyazo_/status/1436754818324783104
Miyazo may be our biggest fan (second only to Oomfielord), and moving Endlight's release date has let them down. Miyazo is the single largest reason we're gong to hit our November target. We cannot deal with another sad emoji.
